author: Verreaux, 1865
status: 백두산 지역의 흔한 텃새(중부 이남에서는 매우 드물다)
summary: 산지 침엽수림에 사는 새로, 백두산 지역에서는 흔한 텃새이지만 중부 이남에서는 매우 드물다. 나무 사이를 재빠르게 옮겨 다닌다. 마른 나무줄기에 스스로 구멍을 파서 둥지를 틀지만 딱따구리가 쓰던 둥지를 쓰기도 하며, 한배에 알을 5~6개 낳는다. 중국 북부와 한국(백두산)에 산다.

art.subject: Chinese Nuthatch (Sitta villosa), adult male in winter: glossy black crown, faint white supercilium, long black eye-stripe from lores to neck sides, cream chin, throat and ear coverts (chin and throat almost white in the centre), pale cream-buff breast, belly and undertail coverts, uniform dark grey-blue hindneck, back, rump and uppertail coverts, central tail feathers like the back, outermost tail feathers black on the basal two-thirds, dark grey-brown flight feathers with narrow blue-grey edges, dark grey-blue tertials and wing coverts
art.pose: clinging to a dead tree trunk beside a self-excavated nest hole
art.scene: mountain conifer forest in the Mt. Baekdu region in winter, with dead standing trunks; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view perched: glossy black crown, faint white supercilium, long black eye-stripe, cream throat, cream-buff underparts, dark grey-blue upperparts
adult male, tail spread from above: grey-blue central feathers, outermost feathers black on the basal two-thirds
